prompt.en: Who was the first to draw a map of Canada's East Coast, in 1497?
prompt.fr: Qui a été le premier à dessiner une carte de la côte Est du Canada, en 1497?

explanation.en: John Cabot, an Italian who had settled in England, sailed in 1497 and drew the first map of this coast. He came ashore on Newfoundland or Cape Breton Island, though England sent no settlers for another century.
explanation.fr: Jean Cabot, un Italien établi en Angleterre, a navigué en 1497 et a dessiné la première carte de cette côte. Il a débarqué à Terre-Neuve ou à l'île du Cap-Breton, mais l'Angleterre n'y a envoyé de colons qu'un siècle plus tard.

source.quote: European exploration began in earnest in 1497 with the expedition of John Cabot

verification.evidence: European exploration began in earnest in 1497 with the expedition of John Cabot, who was the first to draw a map of Canada’s East Coast. … John Cabot, an Italian immigrant to England, was the first to map Canada’s Atlantic shore, setting foot on Newfoundland or Cape Breton Island in 1497 and claiming the New Founde Land for England. English settlement did not begin until 1610
